findings.trigger: Compound names such as db_password=hunter2, client_secret=..., AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=...
findings.impact: These assignments are not catalog-redacted unless a known secret or another pattern matches. This is a realistic recall gap. It is consistent with the bounded frozen catalog, which makes no universal-detection claim.
findings.remediation: Optional future catalog amendment to allow underscore-prefixed or suffixed key names, plus fixtures. Not required for this closure.

findings.trigger: Two BEGIN markers before an END, or a stray END in ordinary prose or docs
findings.impact: The whole envelope fails closed with invalid_payload. This is an availability cost, not a confidentiality cost. It matches the ratified unmatched-marker rule.
findings.remediation: Document in the spec that nested or stray markers reject.

coverage: R1 closed: the whole-call candidate budget is checked before append; PEM, assignment (bisect), URL (find plus bounded back/forward scan) and JWT (start-only, 4096-capped segments) scanners are linear or bounded; probes are consistent
R2 closed: authority ends at whitespace (including Unicode) or /?#; userinfo uses the last @; empty username is accepted; scheme and host are preserved
R3 closed: an epoch containing a known substring or a catalog match rejects without echo

R4 closed: container-depth 32 accepts and 33 rejects; exact and +1 boundaries for canonical 1MiB input and 4MiB output; integer 4096/4097 digits with bit guard; known-secret 128 count and 64KiB limits; partial counts
Aho output links and known-first priority/tie ordering, transitive overlap union, touching spans separate, HMAC over the full NFC union via canonical_json
Errors are closed and raised outside the except context (no args/cause/context); exact builtin types; cycles rejected; atomic with no partial output
No regression found against the 267 pins, 3013 identities and 137 skips; JWT quadratic allegation not substantiated, and the scanner is linear
gaps: Pure library only: no P3 enqueue enforcement, live ingestion, key custody or entropy claim
BM2 timing variance is unrepaired; actual exact-head CI must pass
Peak memory is not constant (per-string encode, candidate lists); explicit bounds only
Catalog recall is limited to the frozen patterns
